summary: Copies a save/settings file and appends a metadata block to the destination filename. Builds the source path by safe-sprintf of a directory (dword_5EC440, falling back to byte_5EA438 when empty) plus a resource-name string at dword_5C5E60. Truncates the destination path to 238 characters, then appends four dwords (dword_5C5E60/5C5E64/5C5E68/5C5E6C) and one word (word_5C5E70) of metadata at the end of the destination filename. Performs the copy with CopyFileA and returns its BOOL result.

operations.description: Initialize NewFileName[253]: copy the first byte of byte_5EA438, zero-fill the remaining 252 bytes, and null-terminate.
Initialize ExistingFileName[253] the same way: copy the first byte of byte_5EA438, zero-fill the rest, null-terminate.
Choose the source directory prefix: dword_5EC440 when non-null, else fall back to byte_5EA438.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(ExistingFileName, aSS, dir, &dword_5C5E60) builds the source path with a '%s%s' format string.
PathTruncationUtility(NewFileName, 238) truncates or fixes the destination path to at most 238 characters.
Append the metadata block to the end of the NewFileName string: dword_5C5E60, then dword_5C5E64, dword_5C5E68, dword_5C5E6C, and finally word_5C5E70.
CopyFileA(ExistingFileName, NewFileName, 0) copies the file with overwrite enabled.
Return the BOOL result of CopyFileA.

clean_pseudocode: const char* dir = dword_5EC440 ? (const char*)dword_5EC440 : byte_5EA438;
